newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: COLOMBO EXCHANGE SET TO LAUNCH SCREEN TRADING.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBO EXCHANGE SET TO LAUNCH SCREEN TRADING.

text.p: Colombo Stock Exchange will launch screen-based trading on Monday, exchange officials said.
They said the new trading system was expected to be inaugurated by President Chandrika Kumaratunga Bandaranaike at 9.30 a.m. (0330 GMT).
The stock exchange began testing the new system during trading hours from June.
"Automation provides a better dissemination of information, because brokers can see actual live prices and announcements on the screen," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena of Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
"There is also uniform time priority and fair play," he added.
"The screen-based trading will improve trading volumes in Colombo," said Prasanna Chandrsekera of John Keells Stock Brokers.
The Colombo benchmark all share index has been on a rise in recent months on the back of good corporate results in the first half of the year and a general uptrend in the economy.
But it fell slightly last week after consolidation set in.
The index closed 5.9 points lower at 850.6 on Friday.
